CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

January 23, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: December 12, 2023
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the December 12, 2023 regular meeting of the Design Review
  Board.

ITEM 2:  MINUTES: January 9, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the January 9, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3:  2208 Westboro Avenue

  •  Request: This is an application for a new front yard wrought iron fence above a
  low wall, five (5) plaster columns, and two wrought iron gates for an existing 1-
  story Ranch style house.
  •  Applicant: Enrique Gomez
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with
  conditions as follows: 1) If the applicant optionally chooses to add lighting on the
  masonry post at the front yard, then this could be subject to City Staff review and
  approval.
  •  The second was by Board member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  109 South Primrose Avenue

  •  Request: This is an application for a new porch column, a portion of new stucco
  wall, and new roof extension on an existing front porch of an existing Ranch style
  house.
  •  Applicant: Marlena Burton, Joel Burton, and David Burton
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  411 North Palm Avenue

  •  Request: This is an application for four (4) revised window sizes, 12 window
  replacements, and new AC units with wood board screening on an existing 1-story
  Tudor style house.

  2
   •  Applicant: Yutao Duan
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:
  • Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with
  conditions as follows: 1) Revise plans to accurately identify which doors are
  existing to remain and existing to be removed; and 2) The applicant shall paint
  the exterior plaster in-fill walls and where windows are being installed to match
  the existing house.
  • The second was by Board member Tsai.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:47 P.M. to
  February 13, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Ng moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:47 P.M.
  •  The second was by Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
